BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Catalog.Domain

ModuleMeta.Name: Catalog Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Product catalog DDD domain: Products, Variants with images/prices/embeddings, OptionTypes with predefined values, and hierarchical Taxonomies/Taxons with auto-classification rules.
ModuleMeta.StandardsAlignment: Evans DDD · Aggregate Root Pattern · Value Objects

Principle.name: Variant as SKU
Principle.Description: Each product variant is a distinct stock-keeping unit with its own price, images, and inventory.
Principle.Rationale: Separates what customers browse (product) from what they purchase (variant).

Principle.name: Taxon Auto-Classification
Principle.Description: Products are assigned to taxons via classification rules rather than manual assignment.
Principle.Rationale: Ensures consistency as the catalog scales; rules are idempotent.

Principle.name: Embedding as Domain Concept
Principle.Description: Product variant images have ML-generated embedding vectors for visual similarity search.
Principle.Rationale: Treats visual features as first-class domain data enabling vector search.

Feature.name: Product Aggregate
Feature.Description: Product with variants, images, prices, classifications, prototypes. Supports activate/discontinue lifecycle.

Feature.name: Variant Images & Embeddings
Feature.Description: Image management per variant with upload/download and ML-generated visual embeddings for similarity search.

Feature.name: Taxonomy Hierarchy
Feature.Description: Multi-level taxonomies with positionable taxons and rule-based product auto-classification.

Feature.name: Option Types
Feature.Description: Product option types (size, color, material) with predefined values for variant configuration.

Category.name: Core Aggregates
Category.Description: Primary domain aggregates for the catalog bounded context.

Abstraction.name: Product
Abstraction.Description: Product aggregate root with variants, classifications, prototypes, and lifecycle state.
Abstraction.Purpose: Central entity for product catalog — browse, search, manage inventory.

Abstraction.name: Variant
Abstraction.Description: SKU-level variant with images, prices, option values, and embeddings.
Abstraction.Purpose: What customers actually purchase; tracks per-SKU price and inventory.

Abstraction.name: Taxonomy
Abstraction.Description: Top-level taxonomy with hierarchical taxons and classification rules.

Abstraction.name: OptionType
Abstraction.Description: Product option type (e.g., size, color) with predefined values.
Abstraction.Purpose: Standardize variant configuration options across products.

Category.name: Supporting Types
Category.Description: Value objects and supporting domain concepts.

Abstraction.name: Image
Abstraction.Description: Product variant image with upload metadata and position.
Abstraction.Purpose: Visual representation of variants for storefront display.

Abstraction.name: Price
Abstraction.Description: Variant price with currency and effective dates.

Abstraction.name: Embedding
Abstraction.Description: ML-generated visual embedding vector for similarity search.
Abstraction.Purpose: Enables visual similarity and reverse image search features.

Steps.Step: Activate makes product visible in storefront
Discontinue hides product but retains data for orders
Delete is soft-delete preserving referential integrity

Mechanism.name: Auto-Classification
Mechanism.Description: When a product is created or updated, classification rules on taxons are evaluated. Matching rules auto-assign the product to the taxon.

AntiPattern.name: Direct Price Mutation
AntiPattern.Avoid: Mutating price objects directly — always create new price instances with effective dates.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Use SetPrice() method that creates a new Price with new effective date.

AntiPattern.name: Variant Without Product
AntiPattern.Avoid: Creating variants independently without a parent product.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Always create variants through the Product aggregate (product.AddVariant()).

Scenario.title: Create Product with Variant
Scenario.Context: Admin creates a new product with one variant.
Scenario.Pattern: var product = Product.Create("T-Shirt", "Comfortable cotton tee");\nproduct.AddVariant("Small", "Red", new Money(29.99m, "USD"), imageUrl);\nawait repository.AddAsync(product);

Scenario.title: Search by Similar Image
Scenario.Context: Storefront customer searches visually similar products.
Scenario.Pattern: var embedding = await inferenceClient.GetEmbeddingAsync(uploadedImage);\nvar similar = await repository.FindByEmbeddingAsync(embedding, threshold: 0.8);
